keeper.description: An older man with a deep, low and slightly tired voice. He speaks slowly and calmly, with gentle pauses between sentences.

scout.description: A young woman with a quick, bright and playful voice, cheeky and warm, as if hiding a smile.

ember.description: A mature woman with a low, husky speaking voice. Her delivery is calm, intimate and quietly urgent.

flint.description: A weathered male storyteller with a gravelly lower register. He speaks gently, with warmth and clear diction.
